notes: Mid-tier Southwest business card. $149 AF. 6,000 anniversary points each year. Free first checked bag, Standard/Preferred seat selection within 48 hours, and boarding no later than group 5. Earns 2,000 TQPs toward A-List per $5,000 spent. The $8K combined cap on gas/restaurant 2x is limited but useful for small businesses.

recurring_credits.name: DoorDash Non-Restaurant Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $10 off one qualifying non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter (DashMart, 7-Eleven, CVS, Safeway, etc.). Requires active DashPass enrollment. Per Chase cobrand-doordash terms.

_no_credits_note: Southwest Premier Business ($149 AF): value is anniversary points (6,000 points, excluded) and a 15% anniversary promo code (% off, excluded). No fixed-USD recurring credits. Re-verified 2026-10-19 vs Chase official page.
